name: Split Chimps
summary: Split Chimps is a VR game that uses movement through your hands! Interact in a fun and creative world where the possibilities are nearly endless! Play around in a game that is active, fun, and exciting! Split Chimps will always make sure to bring the best experience possible to you, and also assures the best experience you could possibly imagine!
